import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')

# Group the data by region and calculate the highest order count
grouped_df = df.groupby('region')['orders'].max().reset_index()

# Plot the bar chart
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.bar(grouped_df['region'], grouped_df['orders'])
plt.xlabel('Region')
plt.ylabel('Highest Order Count')
plt.title('Highest Order Count by Region')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
